lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਇਛਾ ਚਾਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa akal liv rahai karan siu ichhaa chaarah ||
lines.translation: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਪੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਖਵੈ ਕਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: drum sapoor jiu nivai khavai kas bimal beechaarah ||
lines.translation: Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihai tat jaanio sarab gat alakh bidaanee ||
lines.translation: You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhaai sa(n)chio kiran a(n)mrit kal baanee ||
lines.translation: With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜਿ ਲਯੌ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gam pramaan tai paaio sat sa(n)tokh graahaj layau ||
lines.translation: You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਕਲੁ ਸਮੁਲਵੈ ਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਭਯੌ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har parasio kal samulavai jan darasan lahane bhayau ||6||
lines.translation: KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗਹਰਿ ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਦੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bisaas paaio gahar gahu hadarath deeo ||
lines.translation: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਲ ਨਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਠਯੋ ਅਮਿਉ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: garal naas tan nathayo amiu a(n)taragat peeo ||
lines.translation: Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectar deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਦਿ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅਲਖਿ ਕਲ ਧਰੀ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: rid bigaas jaagio alakh kal dharee juga(n)tar ||
lines.translation: Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused His Power throughout the ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sahaj samaadh ravio saamaan nira(n)tar ||
lines.translation: O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਾਰਉ ਚਿਤ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਹਰਨ ਪਿਖੰਤਿਹ ਕਲਮਲ ਤ੍ਰਸਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: udaarau chit daarid haran pikha(n)tih kalamal trasan ||
lines.translation: You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sins are afraid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਲੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਉ ਲਹਣੇ ਰਸਨ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sad ra(n)g sahaj kal ucharai jas ja(n)pau lahane rasan ||7||
lines.translation: Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with my tongue. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam avakhadh naam aadhaar ar naam samaadh sukh sadaa naam neesaan sohai ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੌ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰਹ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g ratau naam siu kal naam sur narah bohai ||
lines.translation: KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਰਵਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam paras jin paaio sat pragatio rav loi ||
lines.translation: Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment of Truth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai athasath majan hoi ||8||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach teerath sach isanaan ar bhojan bhaau sach sadaa sach bhaakha(n)t sohai ||
lines.translation: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach paaio gur sabad sach naam sa(n)gatee bohai ||
lines.translation: The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis sach sa(n)jam varat sach kab jan kal vakhaan ||
lines.translation: KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, and whose fast is the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai sach janam paravaan ||9||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved and certified in the True Name. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਅ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਸਕਲ ਮਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ami drisat subh karai harai agh paap sakal mal ||
lines.translation: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh vas karai sabhai bal ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh man vasai dukh sa(n)saarah khovai ||
lines.translation: Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਕਾਲਖ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur nav nidh dareeaau janam ham kaalakh dhovai ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਟਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: s kahu tal gur seveeai ahinis sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai janam maran dukh jaai ||10||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are taken away. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਤੀਜੇ ਕੇ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: savaeee mahale teeje ke 3 ||
lines.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee purakh sivar saachaa jaa kaa ik naam achhal sa(n)saare ||
lines.translation: Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name is Undeceivable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin bhagat bhavajal taare simarahu soee naam paradhaan ||
lines.translation: He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembrance on His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਪਿਓ ਜੇਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸਿਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit naam rasik naanak lahanaa thapio jen srab sidhee ||
lines.translation: Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਜਨ ਕਲੵ ਸਬੁਧੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਨ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਤਰੀਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kav jan kaly sabudhee keerat jan amaradaas bistareeyaa ||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas is spread throughout the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਵਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਮਵਲਸਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: keerat rav kiran pragat sa(n)saarah saakh tarovar mavalasaraa ||
lines.translation: His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the maulsar (fragrant) tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਹਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪੰਥਿ ਨਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: utar dakhinahi pub ar pascham jai jai kaar japa(n)th naraa ||
lines.translation: In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory.
